item.title: Wheels of Time Car Show doubles number of vehicles, raises $1K
item.description: This year’s Wheels of Time Car Show, held June 20 at Howard Hall, attracted 35 vehicles, more than double the number from last year, and more than 100 people viewed the display.

item.title: Preliminary primary election results have many close races
item.description: Roughly 43% of Chaffee County registered voters participated in the primary election June 30. The countywide results mirrored statewide results in most areas.

item.description: A motorcyclist was seriously injured in a collision with a semitruck at about 2:25 p.m. June 30 on U.S. 285 at mile marker 121 on Poncha Pass, near the turnoff onto Marshall Pass.

item.title: Salida Wine Festival returns, sees large attendance
item.description: After a seven-year hiatus, the Salida Wine Festival returned to Riverside Park June 27, showcasing wines from more than 20 Colorado wineries and bringing in as much traffic as it had in years past.
item.dc:creator: Lijah Sampson, Mail Staff Writer

item.title: Public lands enter Stage 2 fire restrictions
item.description: The U.S. Forest Service’s Salida and Leadville ranger districts and the Bureau of Land Management’s Rocky Mountain District Office all implemented Stage 2 fire restrictions June 29.

item.title: As wildfires rage, officials give tips on disaster prep

item.title: Healthbeat: Alzheimer’s and extreme heat: Exercise caution
item.description: As temperatures rise, extreme heat can have a significant impact on everyone’s safety, but these conditions can be especially stressful and confusing for individuals with Alzheimer’s and other dementias.
